answer: APAC's completed revenue fell more than other regions due to number of orders, which dropped by 28.57% (from 280.0 to 200.0). By comparison, the number of orders in EMEA fell by 2.09%, in North America by 10.30%, and in LATAM by 12.14%. Other components such as average order value (falling between 32.30% and 39.27%), units sold (falling between 0.42% and 13.99%), average unit price (falling between 31.28% and 38.77%), and 1 - average discount (changing between -0.59% and 0.27%) changed by a similar amount in every group and therefore do not explain the difference.
